posts.body: Hi everyone, new to rpgmaker and wanna put a sabertooth tiger mount in my game. but only real sprite sheet ive found is the attached ripped one from a dbz game. anyone know if theres a rmmz compatible sprite sheet that will work

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/inde...d-running-horses-now-with-more-dragons.53552/
whtdragon has big saber cats (under mytholoogicly animals). Be aware that you have to own RPG Maker MV to be allowed to use her stuff.
You get best results with your requests if you follow the
request form
